info.title: DevPath backend API (contract v1 + growth extensions)

Growth.description: See docs/samples/me-growth.json for the full shape

post.summary: Create account (email + password). Sets HttpOnly session cookie.
Sign in. Sets session cookie, returns CSRF token.
Sign out (204). Send X-CSRF-Token if signed in.

get.summary: Current session + CSRF token (call on app load)

put.summary: Change password; signs out other sessions
Partial update. `skills` (if sent) is the confirmed list: adds new, removes unticked.

post.summary: Add a skill (aliases normalised: "JS" → JavaScript). 409 if duplicate.

patch.summary: Update; writes level_up / learned / paused events to the growth log

post.summary: GEMMA: read free text and suggest skills (not saved — confirm via /bulk)

get.summary: Newest first. Query: kind, status, skill, limit (1–100, default 20), cursor

post.summary: Import public PRs/issues of the linked githubLogin (idempotent)
GEMMA: narrate the growth data (facts only)

get.summary: Public profile (only if isPublic). Never includes email.
Contract v1. Query: skills (comma list, default = profile), limit 1–25 (default 10), cursor, includeAssigned=false. Excludes PRs, closed and (by default) assigned issues.
Contract v1. Live state recheck + README/CONTRIBUTING/community docs with source ids

post.summary: Contract v1. GEMMA mentor grounded in server-fetched repo docs. message ≤2000 chars; last 10 history items used (≤2000 chars each).

get.summary: Contract v1. No inference is run; Gemma readiness cached 60s.
ORBIT UI: recommended repositories from real GitHub good-first-issues. Query: skills (comma list), experience, limit <=12. Login optional.
ORBIT UI: contribution roadmap. id = owner__repo. GEMMA writes it from README/CONTRIBUTING; invented files/commands are stripped. generatedBy: gemma | rules (honest fallback).

post.summary: ORBIT UI: chat. {messages:[{role,content}], repoContext?:{id,name,owner}} -> {response, model, sources, caveats}. If Gemma is down returns 200 with an explicit non-AI notice + error.code.

DUMMY PR: Gemma reviews pasted code like a maintainer. {title, description?, code (<=500 lines), filename?, language?, repo?} -> {verdict, summary, strengths, prFeedback, comments[{line,endLine,severity,category,title,explanation,fix,suggestion}], counts, fixedCode, language, model}. Line numbers validated; code never executed.
